input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: §21 is mutual, mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, carves out confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement as uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not damages. The single failure is the cap basis: "Fees" is defined (§1.5–1.6) as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee stated in the first Order Form, and §21.1 further limits recovery to that first Order Form, so the cap is illusory and sits far below six months' fees — walk-away territory rather than the fallback 12-months-of-fees measure. Because every other preferred element is already met, we made the single edit to the cap basis: the greater of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis in §21.1: greater of 12 months' fees under all Order Forms and USD 1,000,000.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is illusory because "Fees" is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form only; we set the mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000. Mutuality, the indirect-damages exclusion, the Excluded Claims carve-outs and the payment-obligation carve-out in §21 are unchanged and remain outside the cap.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
